A warrior was killed by a Giant Spider deep in the Edron Orc Cave.
Edron Orc Cave entrance, southwest of the castle
For levels 8–40 this cave has tough creatures and the rewards are not very good. Gather a team and do all the quests in this cave in one go, instead of making several trips.
Energy doesn't work against {creature:Orc Shaman|Orc Shamans}: bring {item:Great Fireball Rune|Great Fireball Runes}.
1. Going down the Edron Orc Cave

If you are not in **Edron**, take a boat: talk to the harbour captain in your city (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}; you arrive at Edron's port, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}. Go down into the **Edron Orc Cave**: the entrance is a hole **southwest** of Edron castle (if it is covered, open it with the {item:Shovel}). You can also get there through a sewer in the Edron Flats basement, just south of the castle.

In the hole you only find {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen} and {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}. Follow the cave **west** and then **south**. There are a few side rooms, but basically there is only one path.

Here you face {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen}, {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors} and maybe one or two {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers} pulled by other players. Head **west** and follow the passage **north**. Enter the **first room to the east** and go down the hole.
Path on the second floor to the hole
As soon as you fall through the hole you are surrounded by {creature:Orc Shaman|Orc Shamans}. Use {item:Great Fireball Rune|Great Fireball Runes} to clear the room.
Energy attacks don't work against Orc Shamans. The snakes they summon make aiming harder and stop knights from reaching the Shamans.
On this floor head **north**, facing more Orc Shamans and one or two {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}. You will pass through an area with a tiled floor: that means you are on the right path.
Path on the Orc Shaman floor

On the next floor there are {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, several {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders}, {creature:Orc Shaman|Orc Shamans} and maybe one or two Orc Berserkers. Head **north** until you see a big pit with a {creature:Giant Spider} inside. The hole to go down is on the **northeast** side of the pit.
The Giant Spider pit and the hole to the northeast
Go down the hole and kill the {creature:Giant Spider}. The {item:Dark Armor} is inside a corpse on the ground.
Instead of killing the spider, you can set {wiki:Defensive Fighting|Defensive Fighting} mode, run to the corpse, take the loot and come back.

Go back the same way: go up with the {item:Rope} through the Giant Spider pit hole, cross the Orc Shaman floor to the **south** and go up with the Rope through the hole you fell through; on the second floor head **south** and **east** again and, on the first, head **north** and **east** to the entrance hole, where you go up with the Rope once more. Outside, head **north** to Edron and to the port of {npc:Captain Seahorse}.
